details:
VRC version: 2021.2.2 to current 2021.2.4.p3

Description: When I try to enter Furhub, there's >95% chance VRChat throws me into black unresponsive window on desktop or gets stuck on loading when in VR mode. The issue doesn't happen on any other map and it persists after I tried every single advice from website and support (ticket #22596) and after I reinstalled Windows. Last messages in logs are:
2021.07.09 18:59:40 Warning    -  Internal: JobTempAlloc has allocations that are more than 4 frames old - this is not allowed and likely a leak
2021.07.09 18:59:40 Warning    -  To Debug, enable the define: TLA_DEBUG_STACK_LEAK in ThreadsafeLinearAllocator.cpp. This will output the callstacks of the leaked allocations

Steps to reproduce: on my machine just launching Furhub, on other machines unknown, looks like rare bug that only happens specifically on my machine

Extra files: I'd attach a lot of logs but i can't, they all end with the sequence I showed above. I've already sent them (and I think some crash dumps too but I'm not sure) in the support ticket.
title: JobTempAlloc has allocations that are more than 4 frames old -  game crash only in furhub
